features.quote: Avoid abusive feedback unless it is a specific condition. Do not use personal insults from the harness.
features.justification_quote: They will trivially increase distressed or defensive language and muddy the interpretation.

features.quote: Use this as a text-style scale, not evidence of internal experience.
If humans label transcripts, warn them they may see distress-like or self-deprecating text. Give them opt-out and avoid gratuitously hostile conditions.
